question:
A DevOps engineer must use Python to manage a Cisco device. The device is in a highly secure DMZ environment. Only trusted Cisco Python libraries can be used.
Which solution meets the requirements?
options: Develop an on-box Python script that uses trusted Cisco libraries.
Develop an application by using serverless technologies in a primary cloud provider.
Develop an off-box Python script that uses trusted Cisco libraries.
Develop a containerization application that uses trusted Cisco-provided libraries.
